messages.content:
Do you want a single initial message from Alice or several options? If you share a bit of context I can tailor it precisely. In the meantime, here are a few ready-to-use templates in different tones:

1) Professional email introduction (to a potential collaborator)
Subject: Hello from Alice – looking forward to connecting
Hi [Name],
I’m Alice [Last Name], a [role/field] at [Organization]. I’m reaching out because [brief reason]. I’d love to hear more about your work on [topic] and discuss potential ways we might collaborate. Are you available for a quick chat next week?
Best regards,
Alice

2) Friendly LinkedIn/DM outreach (to a new contact)
Hi [Name], I’m Alice, the new [Job Title] at [Company]. I’m excited to join the team and would love to hear about your current projects and how I might help. If you have a moment, could we set up a short chat?

3) Casual message to a friend (informal)
Hey [Name]! I’m Alice — I just moved to [place] and would love to catch up. Want to grab coffee sometime this week or next? :)

4) Opening line for a story (fictional Alice)
Hello, I’m Alice, newly arrived in town and curious about the whispers of the old routes through the mountains. Some say the road is a map of secrets, and I intend to read every line.

If you can tell me:
- the platform (email, text, LinkedIn, in-story narrator, etc.)
- the recipient (friend, colleague, mentor, reader, etc.)
- the tone (formal, warm, casual, adventurous)
- any key details about Alice (profession, goal, relationship to recipient)
I’ll tailor a single message or add more options.
